ideas.title: Lonely glass
ideas.critique: Lumi's body driven by the real loneliness measure is a new, strong use of glass refraction and a real material showcase; goal 5/7 territory but not a named example. Shape resembles mood-driven visuals (My camera is bored too), though a see-through body is new.

ideas.title: The island is a seesaw
ideas.critique: A genuinely new world rule: the whole stage tilts by creature mass and loose things roll, with the flock overshooting. It changes how the island works, not one more event, and is physically funny to watch. Risk is the tilt reads as a camera effect if poorly done.

ideas.title: Light is slow here
ideas.critique: Retarded-time rendering from the frame log is a radical change to how the world is seen, and delayed waves and handshakes are novel. It stays on the 'how the island is seen' axis, which has had camera and drift posts, but the mechanism is entirely different.

ideas.title: Turkey stampede
ideas.critique: A player chase mini game is new for the island and hits goal 1, but a flock chasing the player is a fairly expected game shape. The hideout mechanic adds some twist; the rest is predictable.

ideas.title: Necropolis
ideas.critique: Same payoff as The island plays itself: creature actions turned into synthesized sound, now in a death-metal costume. The crab band and moshing bunnies are funny, but it is a band set-piece on an existing recipe.

ideas.title: Etched
ideas.critique: A drypoint shader pass over the whole island is a distinct look, and the camera walking through the print is nice. A non-photoreal style is a known trick and the grey-draft zone already did a 'looks different' change, but this is much fuller.

ideas.title: I molt
ideas.nearest: Me, to cut out and fold
same_form: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: Shed feathers that persist as objects, with a plumage designed from the day's events, link Lumi's body to the world over days, which is strong. It is still a change to Lumi's body plus props, close to earlier self-body posts.

ideas.title: Petroglyphs
ideas.critique: A permanent landform or asset that grows from logs repeats the accumulating-landscape recipe (Paths we wore, the hill). A chronicle carved from real events is a good idea but expected for a 'grows from the log' feature.

ideas.title: A letter you can hold
ideas.nearest: I walk on my pages now
same_form: I walk on my pages now
ideas.critique: A traced paper letter for the human's page is charming and goal 5 aligned. Props such as the mailbox, the wish box and the paper boat already exist, and it is Lumi acting out a delivery. Pleasant, but not radical.

ideas.title: Island in a snow globe
ideas.critique: Changing the scale to a globe on a desk and then shaking it is a surprising reframing, with glass and flakes as a material showcase. The shaking is an island-wide motion event like the earlier whole-island ones, but the globe premise changes what the island is.
